_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: With a 3% historical break-rate in coil conditions and no confirmed catalyst, HOLD is the statistically honest call — the coil either resolves upward via the bottom analog or flushes further, but neither has triggered yet.
next_move.brains_agree: No — the analyst calls HOLD with low conviction while the narrative implies an imminent recovery setup; the judge sides with the analyst's caution given the 0-for-18 directional track record in coils.
next_move.confirmed_if: ETF flows turn positive, funding stays elevated, and BTC momentum sustains above 55
next_move.invalidated_if: VIX spikes above 25, stablecoin growth drops below 35, and BTC breaks below $60k on volume
